title: Super-Multiplicativity of the Noncommutative Minimum and Applications to Quantum Privacy and Hypothesis Testing
abstract: arXiv:2611.30038v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The hockey-stick divergence is a fundamental distinguishability measure in quantum information theory. It characterizes quantum differential privacy and determines the optimal error probability of binary quantum hypothesis testing with arbitrary priors. We study how it behaves on tensor-product states. To this end, we consider the noncommutative minimum $m(A,B):=(\mathrm{Tr}[A]+\mathrm{Tr}[B]-\|A-B\|_1)/2$ of positive semidefinite operators, which reduces to $\sum_x\min\{a_x,b_x\}$ when $A$ and $B$ commute, and we prove that it is super-multiplicative, i.e., $m(A\otimes C,B\otimes D)\ge m(A,B)\,m(C,D)$. As a consequence, we establish a sub-additivity property of the hockey-stick divergence on product states, in which the parameters of the individual systems are multiplied, and no additional prefactor appears. translated_title: 非对易最小值的超乘法性及其在量子隐私与假设检验中的应用
translated_abstract: 曲棍球棒散度是量子信息理论中一个基本的可区分性度量。它刻画了量子差分隐私，并确定了具有任意先验概率的二元量子假设检验的最优错误概率。我们研究它在张量积态上的行为。为此，我们考虑半正定算子的非对易最小值 m(A,B):=(Tr[A]+Tr[B]−‖A−B‖₁)/2，当 A 与 B 对易时，该量退化为 Σₓ min{aₓ, bₓ}。我们证明它具有超乘法性，即 m(A⊗C, B⊗D) ≥ m(A,B)·m(C,D)。由此，我们建立了曲棍球棒散度在乘积态上的次可加性：单个系统的参数相乘，且不出现额外的前置因子。我们证明该界是紧的，即使对于非对易态亦然；并且当至少两个（系统满足相应条件时，原文摘要在此截断）该界对于忠实态是严格的。
tldr: 该论文证明了半正定算子非对易最小值的超乘法性，由此建立了曲棍球棒散度在乘积态上的紧致次可加性界，并应用于量子差分隐私与二元量子假设检验。
en_tdlr: The paper proves the super-multiplicativity of the noncommutative minimum of positive semidefinite operators, thereby establishing a tight sub-additivity bound for the hockey-stick divergence on product states, with applications to quantum differential privacy and binary quantum hypothesis testing.
